definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating the current period of time.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}は{忙|いそが}しい。
{今月|こんげつ}の{売上|うりあげ}は{好調|こうちょう}だ。
examples.english: This month's sales are doing well.

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}の{日曜日|にちようび}に{会|あ}おう。
examples.notes: {今|こん} + {度|ど} = this time; next time

notes:
{今|こん}〜 is a prefix used with time words to mean 'this' or 'current.'

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {今日|こんにち} (today - formal; nowadays)
- {今週|こんしゅう} (this week)
- {今月|こんげつ} (this month)
- {今年|ことし} (this year - irregular reading)
- {今度|こんど} (this time; next time)
- {今回|こんかい} (this time)
- {今後|こんご} (from now on)
- {今夜|こんや} (tonight)
- {今朝|けさ} (this morning - irregular reading)

NOTE ON READINGS:
Some compounds have irregular readings:
- {今年|ことし} (not こんねん)
- {今朝|けさ} (not こんちょう)
- {今日|きょう} (casual) vs {今日|こんにち} (formal/written)

ANTONYM:
{先|せん}〜 (last; previous) for past time periods
